question: 张坤目前在管的基金有几只？管理总规模是多少？
first_sql: SELECT PSN_NAME AS `基金经理名称`, FUND_NUM_ACTUAL AS `在管基金数量`, ROUND(NET_VALUE / 100000000, 2) AS `管理总规模(亿)` FROM FUND_MANAGER_INFO WHERE PSN_NAME = '张坤' AND HISVALID = 1 AND (CASE WHEN NET_VALUE != 0 THEN MV_OF_STOCK / NET_VALUE ELSE 0 END) >= 0.447 AND (CASE WHEN MV_OF_STOCK != 0 THEN (MV_OF_STOCK - MV_OF_STOCK_PASSIVE) / MV_OF_STOCK ELSE 0 END) >= 0.5
final_sql: SELECT PSN_NAME AS `基金经理名称`, FUND_NUM_ACTUAL AS `在管基金数量`, ROUND(NET_VALUE / 100000000, 2) AS `管理总规模(亿)` FROM FUND_MANAGER_INFO WHERE PSN_NAME = '张坤' AND HISVALID = 1 AND (CASE WHEN NET_VALUE != 0 THEN MV_OF_STOCK / NET_VALUE ELSE 0 END) >= 0.447 AND (CASE WHEN MV_OF_STOCK != 0 THEN (MV_OF_STOCK - MV_OF_STOCK_PASSIVE) / MV_OF_STOCK ELSE 0 END) >= 0.5
